newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values firm, soybeans slip.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values firm, soybeans slip.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis offers moved higher Friday amid market talk of buyer interest from Japan and other Asian countries, grain dealers said.
"The prices look pretty good. We are seeing interest," said one dealer, referring to the three-month-long decline in CBOT September corn futures.
Old-crop soybean values continued to decline as U.S. exporters tried to stay competitive with Brazil soybeans.
Hard red winter and soft red winter wheat values were unchanged. Dealers expect Egypt to tender soon for wheat but as of late Friday no tender had been announced.
